hypothesis: A lower and functionally redundant mono-red Prowess/Burn shell can preserve the successful Pioneer opening pattern under the Thun three-copy rule if it uses at least four distinct turn-one threat packages, six repeatable spell-damage creatures, explicit reload, and no attempted one-card imitation of the missing rare midgame role-compression package.

keep: Two or three lands plus a turn-one package and at least one cheap follow-up spell.
One land only when the hand has at least two one-mana plays and the land produces red without entering tapped.
Four lands only with Monastery Swiftspear or another turn-one threat plus real card flow.
mulligan: Zero lands or five or more lands.
A hand with pump spells but no creature.
A hand whose first pressure card costs two mana and has no direct burn sequence.
Ramunap Ruins as the only land when the hand requires repeated colored activation without accepting the life cost.

white_tokens.notes: Pyroclasm is symmetrical and should be sequenced before rebuilding. Smash to Dust is primarily for artifact tokens or one-toughness boards, not assumed to be a universal sweeper.

artifacts.notes: Retain Abrade. Do not use the Defender or one-damage mode unless the board makes it relevant.

spell_heavy.notes: Magebane Lizard triggers for both players and becomes more punishing as multiple noncreature spells are cast in the same turn.

lifegain.notes: The lifegain lock lasts only for the current turn; cast it on the decisive damage turn rather than treating it as permanent hate.

graveyard_or_library_cheat.notes: Runestone does not stop cards entering from hand or exile and does not itself pressure the opponent.
